wiki.title: Martha Feltus
wiki.extract: Martha "Marty" Feltus is an American politician from Vermont. She serves in the Vermont House of Representatives. From 1980 to 1997 she served on the Lyndonville, Vermont planning commission, zoning board of appeals, and as a village trustee. From 1997 to 2018 she was on the village's select board. Feltus was first elected to the Vermont House of Representatives in 2012, and served until 2023. She was re-elected to the assembly for the 2025 session. She previously worked for Weidmann Electrical Technology.
